text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, lead-style research, Excel, SQL, Google Sheets, Power BI, and data visualization.

I’ve built similar data workflows before. In “Marketing attribution analysis” for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit, which helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and reduced CAC by 12% the next quarter. In “Shopify customer segments” for Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend, which made up 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and lifted email revenue by 19%.

I can compile a clean, organized list of 150 home care companies with the decision maker’s LinkedIn, name, email, and phone number.
